key: PI Controller with Integral Anti-Windup (Discrete or Continuous)
title: PI Controller with Integral Anti-Windup (Discrete or Continuous)
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time PI control with integral anti-windup, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Proportional gain} sets the k p, {Integral gain} sets the k i, {Upper saturation limit} sets the b, {Lower saturation limit} sets the a and {Integrator initial condition} sets the initial integrator value. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Upper saturation limit
params.values: B 5 (default) | scalar greater than the value of the Lower saturation limit parameter
